sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The singer said that he was ‘already feeling better’ but forthcoming dates on his mammoth farwell tour will not now go ahead Rod Stewart has cancelled all coming dates on his farewell tour after undergoing a routine heart procedure. On 9 August, Stewart, 81, pulled a performance in Ohio at the last minute. After the successful insertion of a coronary stent, he announced that all dates would be cancelled. Continue reading...
